messages.en: Does that wound on your finger still sting?
Not as much now. I cleaned it earlier.
I've finished this painting. Does it look good?
It's lovely! I want to see it in person, not just in a photo.

senses.en_definition: To fail to remember or recall something.
To neglect or lose sight of one's responsibilities, obligations, or circumstances.

collocations.en: get carried away; forget one's roots

messages.en: Don't forget to bring the tickets, okay? I'm already waiting at the entrance.
I've got them in my bag. I'm looking for a parking spot. I'll be there in a minute.
Okay, I'll wait right here. Message me when you're close.

senses.en_definition: To no longer remember someone or something.

collocations.en: don't forget all they've done for you

senses.en_definition: To put something out of one's mind; to let go of it.

collocations.en: put it out of your mind

senses.en_definition: To disregard or neglect one's responsibilities or obligations.

messages.en: I'm still annoyed about that whole ticket thing. We only found out the concert was cancelled when we got there.
Just let it go. We've got our money back, haven't we? Let's find another concert to go to.
Yeah, you're right. I can't be bothered thinking about it anymore.
